assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: layered 2D pixel-art videogame title-screen background, landscape 16:9. Create a beautiful calm blue ocean under a blue sky with soft pixel clouds and a warm pale sun, an expansive tranquil seascape. Crisp hand-placed-looking pixel clusters like a polished 16-bit adventure RPG, coherent low-resolution pixel grid, limited rich cyan/azure/navy palette, NO antialiasing, NO painting, NO blur. Horizon at 46 percent of image height, water occupies lower half, rippling turquoise ocean highlights, clear open space in the lower center where a fishing boat sprite will be composited by the game. Some faint rocky island silhouettes very far on the horizon at outer edges. Upper central sky relatively uncluttered for title typography rendered separately by the game. The ocean is lovely, inviting and quiet. Absolutely no boats, no people, no characters, no buildings, no UI, no lettering, no watermark. Wide cinematic framing.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D pixel-art game sprite of a small fishing boat carrying exactly three adventurers. The entire boat and all three people as one isolated cutout, true transparent background. Side view with a little three-quarter depth, prow points right. Small charming weathered wooden fishing boat with dark navy and teal painted hull, wooden trim, rope coil, modest fishing cabin at the rear left with short mast, simple pennant, no sail. EXACTLY THREE adventurers stand together on the open deck and are clearly visible from waist up: left a burly fair-skinned red-bearded red-haired sailor wearing a blue knit cap and blue naval coat with brass trim, holding a heavy iron anchor; center a slender female harpoon sharpshooter wearing a dark green beret and brown long coat, holding a harpoon rifle; right a brown-skinned black-haired young diver wearing a blue-and-black diving suit with brass harness buckles and round blue headphones, no helmet. Charming slightly chunky heroic character silhouettes like a polished 16-bit RPG. Crisp pixel clusters at consistent low resolution, 2D sprite art, limited palette, no smooth outlines, no glossy 3D shading. Boat approximately twice as wide as its height, entirely contained with generous transparent margin. Calm upright poses, characters not enormous relative to boat but readable, each recognizable. No water, no sky, no ground, no shadow underneath, no scene background, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 landscape pixel-art background for dialogue in an underwater cave in a nautical adventure RPG. An atmospheric submerged cavern with dark blue rock arch and short hanging stalactites forming the upper frame, beautiful soft turquoise light filtering down from an underwater fissure in the upper center, deep teal water haze in the distance, uneven navy stone ledges at both sides, a rocky sandy underwater floor, a few small emerald and sea-green seaweed clumps rooted at the left and right edges, small bright cyan bioluminescent accents. Large clear relatively dark open middle ground for three full-body character portraits to stand; bottom 35 percent is darker, quiet and low detail to support a dialogue panel composited by the game. Polished detailed 16-bit RPG pixel-art scene: crisp pixel clusters, limited blue/teal/navy palette, no smoothing, no painted brushwork, no blur. Foreground and midground layers have depth without competing with the characters. Gentle moody beautiful lighting, coherent low-resolution pixel grid. No people, no boat, no text, no lettering, no HUD, no panel frame, no watermark. This is the complete environment background only, no falling droplets baked into the image (animated by the game).
